description: This file is a shell script for managing the download process of an application, including handling retries, codebig (alternative server) logic, blocking mechanisms for failed attempts, and preparing curl commands for downloading files from specified URLs with security features like TLS and OAuth signing.

methods.name: applicationDownload
methods.description: Handles the process of downloading the specified application package, managing retries, and switching between direct and codebig download modes based on network conditions and previous failures.

methods.name: getCodebigUrl
methods.description: Generates a signed URL for codebig download, including OAuth signing and handling SSR URL encodings.

methods.name: IsCodeBigBlocked
methods.description: Checks if the codebig server is currently blocked due to previous failures based on timestamp files.

methods.name: IsDirectBlocked
methods.description: Checks if direct download mode is blocked based on failure timestamp files.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Outputs usage information for the script.
